assessment.why: Ella's disposal of actual stolen original, direct target-glass access, and unresolved false donation claim produce strongest coherent case. Final defense adds only unverified misidentification. No witness or personalized fragment/favor custody proves the whole chain, so reasonable alternatives remain.

plausibility_notes: Statements naming evidence should not all be treated as independently proved. The packet leaves miniature and fragment wrapper without a named owner; Ella's claim could be genuine mistaken handling after another culprit's transfer.
